subject.title: fix(gateway): force-discard ACP runtime after cancel/close timeout

question: Must this PR provide a live stuck-ACP recovery transcript before merge, or is the deterministic hanging-operation coverage sufficient for an explicit proof override?
rationale: The patch is technically clean at the reviewed head, but repository policy treats real after-fix behavior as a merge gate for external runtime PRs, and this concurrency change affects both session state and gateway availability.

options.title: Require live ACP proof
options.body: Keep the merge blocked until redacted logs show cleanup timeout, successful reset/delete completion, a fresh runtime or process, and no late output from the retired generation.

options.title: Override with deterministic proof
options.body: Explicitly accept the focused hanging-operation tests and green CI as sufficient evidence for this difficult-to-provision failure mode.

recommendation.title: Require live ACP proof
recommendation.body: Keep the merge blocked until redacted logs show cleanup timeout, successful reset/delete completion, a fresh runtime or process, and no late output from the retired generation.
